title: Why can't I overdraft my Green Account (checking)?
summary: This document explains that Green Account (checking) overdrafts are not supported: transactions are declined if they would create a negative balance. It also states there are no overdraft protection transfers from other accounts, with a $0.00 fee for such transfers, and advises adding funds to retry after a decline.
